_about: Approval records from decision to the card backlog, updated with Isa's answers of 27 Sep 2026: the Factory ingests this pack; volumes come from measurement; trial dates are set after the backlog is amended; the Owner holds hashed keys; value is measured from idea to artifact and from ratification to return. Gate 1 and Gate 2 put the change on the backlog. Gate 3 records are signed just in time, before the cards that name them start.

gates.name: Decide the idea
gates.purpose: Exit Idea stage. One sitting; all evidence exists.

gates.name: Onto the backlog
gates.purpose: Ingest the pack, check it against the real Factory, ratify the plan, admit Phase 0.

gates.name: Just in time
gates.purpose: Records the backlog itself waits on. Each is signed before the first card that names it starts.

records.title: Constitution
records.approves: The eight principles, the five golden allocation rules (G1-G5) and rules R1-R20, as extracted verbatim in this pack's constitution section.

records.title: Model portfolio
records.approves: The rolling policy (P1, P2, P6-P8) and the starting menu of seven models on API tokens (pack: menu). Replaces 'start from today's four models'.

records.title: Trial operating rules
records.approves: For the trial: the seven-model menu on API tokens, the Scaler (R14) with held demand counted, a 15-minute target, a 1-hour cost-band wait, quality floor 0.8 and cost band 1.5; no training on our data (R15); the burn cap (R16); R17-R19; and R20 for any searched configuration.

records.title: Trial budget and value measure
records.approves: An initial monthly ceiling of about $2,500 (claim CL-04), with R16's hourly cap at 2x the trailing seven-day average. The ceiling is reset by R16's formula once the baseline measures real volume (C0.11). Value is not set in advance: it is measured in two segments, cost from idea to artifact (M06) and return from ratification to production and monetisation (M07), by the idea value ledger (C0.09).
evidence: Isa, 27 Sep 2026: an idea is worth nothing without action

records.title: Exit Idea stage
records.approves: Move to design under the Amend scenario, through this pack.
records.status: Ready once AR-01 to AR-05 are signed

records.title: Alignment Record and authority to ingest
records.approves: The intent of the change as stated in this pack (README: intent and scope), its assumptions (twin_parameters), open experiments (X1-X14) and open items. Authorises the existing Factory to ingest the pack and produce the Fit Report (C0.00), and nothing else.

records.title: Protected governance paths
records.approves: The protected path list and the interim gate (Checker plus Isa) until the Release Gate exists (C0.02, then C2.02).
evidence: Protected path list from the Fit Report
records.status: To produce: the path list comes from the Fit Report

records.title: Trial criteria and measurement plan
records.approves: What will be measured (M01-M20), for how long before the trial (shadow period), the trial configuration the predictions are made for, and the success and kill criteria taken from X1-X14. Rollback to Director -> Worker -> Checker. Dates and scope are not set here (AR-12b).
records.status: To produce: drafted by the Director from the pack

records.title: Ratified Plan
records.approves: The card seeds in this pack plus the deltas proposed in the Fit Report, phase by phase, with their dependency graph and acceptance contracts; every [PROPOSED] threshold accepted or changed.
records.status: To produce: after the Fit Report

records.title: Backlog admission
records.approves: The existing Factory creates the ratified Phase 0 cards, each carrying its pack card ID. Each later phase is admitted when the previous phase's exit is approved: through the interim gate (C0.02) for Phases 0-1, through the Release Gate (C2.02) from Phase 2 on.

records.title: Quality standards and constants
records.approves: Maximum markdown rate per institution and tier, set from the baseline's measured variance (C0.11); any window, hysteresis, stretch-trial or back-off constant not already fixed in the constitution.

records.title: Owner of live operation
records.approves: Who owns incident, restore and hotfix (value-stream step 13).

records.title: Ratification tiers and attention budget
records.approves: Which ideas need Isa's ratification, which the Council may ratify, and Isa's weekly attention budget.

records.title: Vendor and data terms
records.approves: API accounts with the menu's vendors; no-training terms confirmed for every tier used (R15); rate limits recorded as Scaler caps; routes, including a second route for Muse Spark; Muse Spark availability for the Owner's account region [Unverified]; review of the terms for Heliosvera IP by a qualified adviser where terms are unclear. Key custody is settled: the Owner holds the keys, hashed in the Factory (OI-04 remains for how adapters obtain usable credentials).

records.title: Trial dates and scope
records.approves: Trial start, duration and scope, set after the cards are in the backlog, from the backlog forecast and the measured demand profile.

after_backlog: A phase-exit approval for each phase (interim gate for Phases 0-1; Release Gate from Phase 2)
The trial go / no-go (CT.03) against AR-12a's criteria
Constitutional amendments as the trial teaches: human-ratified, as a new version
